method.within_edge_assignment: replaces current owner only when target is unowned or all owners are in the same source edge
method.cross_edge_assignment: retained as provisional; does not silently remove existing owner
method.completion: verified current_cell reaches zero and dominates later graph text
method.boundary: shadow reconstruction, not runtime permission gate
